title: A legal way for the Builder to say the contract and a check disagree
description: When a test and the contract disagree, the Builder has no honest move today except editing the test until it is green. A dispute verdict gives it one: it names the clause, what conflicts with it and why, stops the loop, and hands the human a three-way choice - fix the code, the clause, or the check.

clauses.text: The handoff schema accepts dispute as a Builder self-verdict, and a dispute verdict requires a dispute object with clause, conflicts_with and because.
clauses.observable_by: schemas/handoff.schema.json lists dispute in builder_self_verdict and an if/then requires dispute, whose required keys are clause, conflicts_with and because

clauses.text: The run summary can end with termination_reason disputed.

The builder, critic, build command and loop protocol all say a dispute stops the loop and goes to the human as fix the code, the clause, or the check, and the builder prompt forbids editing a locked file to get green.
clauses.observable_by: each of those files mentions dispute and the three-way choice, and agents/builder.md contains the sentence about following the contract and never editing a locked file
